line: Help now has a guide for your desk: your main jobs, step by step, each with a link to its screen.
The tour starts by itself only once on each device. Open it again any time from Help.
On a computer, the ? beside each screen's name opens help for that screen.
Help now lists recent changes under What's new, and this note shows them after each update.
Bed holds, ED counts, reports and archived history now stay consistent through access changes and interrupted saves.
Ward referrals show permitted progress while keeping other destinations private.
The ward's Act now card for stopped transports says the beds are still pulled again.
Clearer wording: pulled beds say pulled, delayed discharges say held up, and form times say as written.
If another desk changes a record while your form is open, saving now tells you instead of overwriting it.
Moving someone to an open bed asks for a reason unless they are Voluntary. Extending a form needs the new expiry date.
Recording a departure asks where they went, with nothing chosen for you. Pulling a bed names who it was pulled for.
Where nothing is recorded the screens say so, and the referral summary labels what came from the referral letter.
Phone ED rows show the UMRN beside the name. The practice hospital feed names each person and a confirm can be undone.
Handover keeps your shift past midnight, the forecast covers long weekends, and an ED accept needs two separate taps.
